sources.cap_direct_tip: A direct-search URL template is registered — click “Search” on a card to jump straight to that site's results page
sources.cap_local_tip: Full text is in the FoJin database — read, cite, and search it directly on this site
sources.cap_remote_tip: Full text is hosted at the original site and readable there; FoJin only provides navigation and deduplication
sources.cap_iiif_tip: Offers IIIF or high-resolution scans, ideal for manuscripts, woodblock prints, paintings, and other visual resources
sources.cap_api_tip: Offers a machine-readable API (REST / RDF / IIIF, etc.) for programmatic access
sources.hero_title: Type once, jump straight to {{n}} sources
sources.hero_sub: Enter a keyword and every template-enabled card below will generate a direct search link into that source
sources.hero_result: Generated direct links for “{{query}}” across {{n}} sources — scroll down for the “Search” button on each card
sources.trust_provenance_tip: All data comes from digital resources publicly released by academic institutions such as CBETA, BDRC, SAT, and SuttaCentral; every record keeps its original source identifier and link.
sources.trust_sync_tip: Kept in sync with upstream sources via Git, APIs, and bulk imports, so the collection reflects the latest releases.
sources.trust_dedup_tip: Copies of the same text across sources are automatically identified and merged into a single record, keeping each source's own identifiers and links.
sources.trust_coverage_tip: Spanning {{regions}} countries and regions and {{langs}} languages, across Chinese, Tibetan, Theravāda, Sanskrit, and other Buddhist traditions.
sources.fulltext_only_tip: Show only sources with full text on FoJin or readable at the original site (hides link-only directories)
sources.stats_hint_field: (a source can belong to multiple research fields)
sources.stats_hint_lang: (a source can belong to multiple languages)
sources.health_degraded_tip: The site is reachable, but the target page returns an error (e.g. 403/404). The link may be stale — verify before visiting.
sources.health_cert_invalid_tip: The site's HTTPS certificate failed validation; your browser may show a security warning.
sources.health_unreachable_tip: Our automated probe could not reach this source from a single server — usually a datacenter-IP block or a temporary network issue; your browser can typically still access it. Sources that stay unreachable long-term are periodically reviewed and delisted if necessary.
sources.health_moved_tip: The site now redirects to another domain; the original links may have moved.
sources.badge_searchable_tip: The site offers search; if a URL template is registered, a direct “Search” button appears below
sources.badge_iiif_tip: Offers IIIF or high-resolution scans (manuscripts, woodblock prints, paintings, etc.)
